title: CMAR Services for Fletcher Free Library Renovation
short_description: Construction manager at risk sought for renovation of Burlington's Fletcher Free Library.
project_location: Fletcher Free Library, 235 College Street, Burlington, Vermont 05401, USA
project_scope: Renovation of the Fletcher Free Library in Burlington, Vermont. The tender seeks a Construction Manager at Risk for preconstruction and construction services for an existing library building refurbishment project. Total stated construction cost is 23.0 million USD.
services: Construction Manager at Risk (CMAR) preconstruction and construction services; rehabilitation and refurbishment; possible design-build/developer-related coordination as listed in requested disciplines.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a CMAR/construction management procurement, not a direct structural design or specialist engineering tender.
- Building renovation of a library is generally not a core sbp target type.
- No indication of long-span, special structural systems, lightweight structures, bridges, roofs, or other signature sbp-relevant features.
- Refurbishment can be relevant in some cases, but the notice provides no specific structural planning component.
fee_explanation: No explicit design fee is stated. The notice is for CMAR preconstruction and construction services, not for structural engineering fees.
references_qualifications: Statements of Qualifications are requested from qualified Construction Management firms for CMAR services. No detailed minimum reference counts or specific qualification thresholds are stated in the provided text.

notes: Project number: 22-0825. Non-mandatory pre-submission meeting and site visit: 2026-07-14 08:30 AM EDT at 235 College Street, Burlington, VT. Questions deadline: 2026-07-21 02:00 PM EDT. Source lists disciplines requested as Design Build/Developer, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, and Construction/Project Management.
